Let \(n=x+1\). Then the equation becomes
\[
a^2+n^2=625 \quad \text{with } a=2x-y.
\]
Since \(0\le x\le y\), we have \(a\le x=n-1\), so \(a\le n-1\).

Integer solutions to \(a^2+n^2=625=25^2\) with \(n\ge 1\):
\[
(0,25),\ (7,24),\ (-7,24),\ (24,7),\ (-24,7),\ (15,20),\ (-15,20),\ (20,15),\ (-20,15).
\]
Reject those with \(a>n-1\):
- \((24,7)\): \(24>6\)
- \((20,15)\): \(20>14\)

The remaining \(7\) solutions give valid pairs \((x,y)\).

\[
\boxed{7}
\]
